findings.desc: Test-coverage blocker: snapshot reuse is verified only through a direct test-only buildDoneChecklist call with evidenceHashSnapshot. rg shows no production DONE/session/lifecycle gate call site supplies evidenceHashSnapshot, so the real gates still call buildDoneChecklist without the command-local snapshot and can keep recomputing/falling back while the new smokes pass. This leaves actual unchanged snapshot reuse across DONE/review gates unproven, though dirty material rejection, story-owned drift, no-snapshot fallback, and docs boundary are covered by focused smokes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by threading a command-local EvidenceHashSnapshot through runDoneOracleGate, buildStoryReadinessReport/buildDoneRows, and session_brief DONE pre-check, with buildDoneChecklist fallback preserved when no reusable snapshot is available. Evidence: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/verification-freshness-smoke.js; npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-escalation-freshness-root; node packages/main/dist/tasks/delivery-check-freshness-smoke.js; git diff --check.
